name: Shimizu (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Shimizu town emblem in white and maroon: an outlined white ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing maroon stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Shimizu, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 October 1965.

features.role: Shimizu town emblem — an outlined white ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing maroon stylised characters
